node.title: XR SL-2 full-joint-rank maximal split-divisor count
node.statement: At every prize-row high band-proper depth for which rank J_d=2d, the maximal selected post-strip locator set R_d of SL-2-RES satisfies 25|R_d|<=17n^2. Exact maximality, L_P>=2 first-match selection, and strip survival are retained. Full linear codimension alone is not treated as an anti-concentration proof.
